description: What the member returned, as JSON, and the document afterwards.

member.description: The member path as SOLIDWORKS spells it.

interfaces.description: The interface of each object the path was called on, in order, for example IModelDoc2, IModelDocExtension.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

document.description: The document a document or reference target was in, or the one rebuilt; absent for an app call that rebuilt nothing.

result.description: The member's value, in SOLIDWORKS' units: a number, string, boolean or array as SOLIDWORKS returned it (enums as their number, NaN as null); an object as {"ref": "r1...", "interface": "IFace2"} when SOLIDWORKS can persist it, else {"interface": "IModelDocExtension"} only. Absent for nothing returned.

out.description: Each ref or out argument after the call, by its parameter's name, for example {"Status": 0}.

errors.description: How many features have a rebuild error.

warnings.description: How many features have a rebuild warning.

items.description: A feature with a rebuild error or warning.

code.description: SOLIDWORKS' error code name (swFeatureError_e), for example swFeatureErrorFilletNoEdge.

warning.description: True for a warning, false for an error.

items.description: Each feature with an error or warning.

rebuild.description: When the document was rebuilt: its rebuild errors and warnings afterwards.

duration_ms.description: How long the call took, ms.
